# `browser-tab list`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab list [FLAGS]`

List open browser windows and tabs (Chrome/Brave/Chromium/Edge/Safari)

## Flags

### `--browser <name>`

Restrict to one browser: chrome|chromium|brave|edge|safari

### `--window <id>`

Restrict to one window (opaque windowId)

### `--url <substring>`

Filter tabs by URL substring

### `--fields [set]`

Field set: summary (no tab rows), core (trimmed) or full

**Choices:**

- `core`
- `full`
